main.summary: Options that control segmented transfer behavior in DataServices.

property.name: DefaultSegmentSizePolicy
property.summary: Default segment size policy applied when an open request does not provide one.

property.name: EnforceMinimumSegmentBytes
property.summary: When true, non-final uploaded segments smaller than the effective minimum size are rejected before payload consumption.

property.name: EnforceMaximumSegmentBytes
property.summary: When true, uploaded segments larger than the effective maximum size are rejected before payload consumption.

property.name: TemporaryUploadPath
property.summary: Optional directory used to stage non-seekable upload payloads before hash validation and storage writes. When unset, the service falls back to Path.GetTempPath().
